name: 权重与激活量化

name: 极低比特与混合精度
query: ((abs:"mixed precision" OR abs:"low-bit" OR abs:"1-bit" OR abs:"2-bit" OR abs:"binary weights") AND abs:quantization) AND (abs:"language model" OR abs:transformer OR abs:LLM)
